changes: Single cached group SIGTERM attempt; permission and unexpected errors remain final
ESRCH requires close; exit alone is insufficient; finite close timeout without escalation
Browser launch/capture/close failures preserve server settlement and all original errors
Import is inert; no output-directory creation or capture on require
scope: Existing workspace producer only; no shared legacy owner or global lifecycle control changes
cliFailureReporting: Preserve original process.exit(1), so a refused detached child does not prevent failure return; no additional child signal.
additionalGuards: Reject PID1 before any group signal
Reject owned server closure before capture, during capture or before intended shutdown
Deduplicate original errors without suppressing distinct cleanup failures
